patch.reasoning: Two edits remove conflicts or latent failures seen in this batch. (1) A party-size reply with no hotel requested was turned into filter_flights(num_people=...) in 2 of 8 tasks. It only passed because the call raised before saving, so on a valid schema it would have saved an extra flight key and failed. The fast-rule sentence 'At most get_results_from_cache for each flight key' invites this, and it conflicts with the slow block, which says the reply adds no constraint. (2) Key-naming rules conflict: Rule 23 says filtered_<x>1, the slow block says final_<x>, and the agent used arbitrary names. Those tasks still passed, so names are not scored. Collapsing the naming scheme to 'any unused name' follows the meta-skill's advice to shrink and de-conflict, and it makes the prompt shorter.
